hypotheses.title: Fundamental Cash-to-Debt Solvency Coverage with Delta Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Measures corporate balance sheet solvency and liquidity cushion by ranking cash and short-term investments relative to long-term debt (cash_st / debt_lt). Fortress balance sheet firms resist credit tightening and generate superior risk-adjusted alpha. The user has zero approved alphas on cash_st.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high cash balances represent idle unproductive capital rather than solvency protection.

candidates.rationale: Balance Sheet Cash-to-Debt Solvency Ratio with 5-Day Reversal

hypotheses.title: Fundamental Short-Term Cash Yield Dislocation with Delta Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: When a firm's short-term cash and liquid reserves reach 1-year historical highs relative to its stock price (cash_st / close), the equity trades at deep net-cash discount valuation multiples. Zero prior exposure in the user's portfolio.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high cash yield is rapidly consumed by operational cash burn.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(cash_st, 60) / close, 252), subindustry) - 0.15 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Balance Sheet Cash Yield Dislocation with 5-Day Reversal

hypotheses.title: Intraday Market Maker Inventory Dislocation via Volume-Weighted Average Price (VWAP)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures institutional closing order imbalance: when closing price settles below the daily volume-weighted average price (vwap), market makers absorb overnight inventory imbalances that mean-revert over a 5-day decay window. The user has zero approved alphas using VWAP.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if VWAP discounts persist into multi-week downward trends.

candidates.expression: 0.80 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 5), subindustry) - 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Smoothed VWAP Dislocation with 5-Day Liquidity Reversal
